notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5-6); fund balance 4,349,833 -> 5,327,172 with bond proceeds 3,315,000 and transfers 641,999 in/out. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement Totals column (p9) with net position roll-forward 8,895,731 -> 8,933,946; nonoperating Intergovernmental grants printed negative (154,451) and recorded as printed. Statement Taxes split with printed rows: General Fund schedule tax lines (p13) and fund-column Taxes cells (p5); Economic Development and Street and Sidewalk Maintenance taxes are sales tax by exact subtraction from the Statement of Activities local option sales taxes; Debt Service taxes stay unlabeled. Intergovernmental split into the General Fund schedule rows (p13) plus the Economic Development and Debt Service fund cells. Miscellaneous split into Keno Gaming (p17), General Fund Other revenues (p13) and the Economic Development fund cell 17,918. Business-type Other revenues 20,284 split using the Statement of Activities business-type general revenues (leases and rentals 13,834, contributions and miscellaneous 6,450, p3). ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet Cash and cash equivalents 3,277,019 (p4); cash at county treasurer 46,739 and restricted cash 1,253,374 are separate lines; beginning cash not printed. Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1-2), lines tagged by column. Detail: General Fund schedule (p13-16, no budget column), nonmajor combining statement per fund (p17); no proprietary statement-column detail (as FY2023/FY2024). The combined all-funds budgetary-basis statement (p12, one 'General All-Purpose' column mixing all funds) was not recorded to avoid double counting; major funds Economic Development, Debt Service and Street and Sidewalk Maintenance have no schedule, so no detail.
